title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Strengthening the Adjudication of Agriculture-Related Cases to Provide Judicial Guarantees for Rural Economic Development
keywords_en: Guarantee; People's Court on Strengthening Agriculture-related Cases
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Strengthening the Trial of Agriculture-Related Cases to Provide Judicial Guarantee for Rural Economic Development

Fa [2004] No. 124

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army, and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

Since the Sixteenth National Congress of the Communist Party of China (CPC), the CPC Central Committee, proceeding from the strategic overall situation of ensuring sound, sustained and rapid development of the national economy and advancing the pace of building a moderately prosperous society in all respects, has successively formulated and promulgated a series of major policies and measures to promote agricultural development, maintain rural stability, and increase farmers' income. In order to give full play to the function of adjudication, protect farmers' legitimate rights and interests according to law, promote the strategic adjustment of the agricultural and rural economic structure, and effectively maintain social stability in rural areas, the following notice is hereby given on issues concerning further strengthening the trial of agriculture-related cases:

1. Fully recognize the important significance of strengthening the trial of agriculture-related cases. People's courts at all levels shall adopt various forms, organize adjudicators to carefully study the Decision of the CPC Central Committee on Several Issues Concerning the Improvement of the Socialist Market Economy System, the Opinions of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council on Several Policies for Promoting Farmers to Increase Income, and other relevant documents since the Sixteenth National Congress, deeply grasp the essential spirit of the relevant policies of the CPC Central Committee, and fully understand the important significance of the issues concerning agriculture, rural areas, and farmers in the process of building a moderately prosperous society in all respects; they shall, from the height of implementing the important thought of Three Represents and fulfilling the requirement of providing justice for the people, raise the awareness of the importance of strengthening the trial of agriculture-related cases; on the basis of careful investigation and research, they shall, in light of local actual conditions, formulate practical and feasible measures, give full play to the various functions of the people's courts, and provide powerful judicial guarantee for promoting rural economic development.

2. Increase the punishment of criminal activities that hinder agricultural development, undermine rural stability, and damage farmers' legitimate rights and interests. According to law, severely punish criminal activities that seriously harm farmers' interests, such as producing and selling counterfeit and inferior pesticides, fertilizers, seeds, and other agricultural materials, to the greatest extent possible to recover farmers' losses, protect farmers' legitimate rights and interests, and ensure the smooth progress of agricultural production; for crimes that use authority to intercept national financial subsidies, agricultural inputs, and relief funds and materials, and to embezzle or misappropriate rural collective property, they shall be severely punished according to law; for criminal activities characterized by local tyranny, bullying the people, and bearing the characteristics of organized crime of a mafia nature, they shall be resolutely punished according to law to maintain normal economic and social order in rural areas and protect the personal rights, democratic rights, and safety of life and property of the vast number of farmers.

3. Further strengthen the trial of civil and administrative cases related to agriculture. When handling various types of civil and administrative dispute cases related to agriculture, people's courts at all levels shall resolutely implement the guiding ideology of protecting farmers' legitimate rights and interests according to law. For dispute cases concerning infringement of land contractual management rights, where farmers request compensation for losses, they shall be supported according to law; for disputes arising from illegal interception or deduction of farmers' contractual income, where farmers request the return of contractual management income, they shall be supported according to law; for disputes arising from the transfer of contractual management rights, contracts that violate the principle of voluntariness and force farmers to transfer contractual management rights shall be confirmed as invalid according to law; for compensation dispute cases caused by losses due to fake and inferior agricultural materials, where farmers request compensation for losses, the people's court shall support them according to law; for disputes over arrears of payment arising from the sale of agricultural and sideline products, where farmers request the other party to pay the arrears and bear liability for breach of contract, as well as cases involving arrears of wages of migrant workers, the cases shall be promptly accepted and tried according to law.

4. Do a good job in the enforcement of agriculture-related cases and the handling of petitions related to litigation. People's courts at all levels shall earnestly do a good job in the enforcement of agriculture-related cases and the handling of petitions related to litigation. For agriculture-related cases across jurisdictions, enforcement may be entrusted, and the entrusted people's court shall actively take measures to enforce; for cases that are difficult to enforce due to the influence of local protectionism, enforcement may be designated or upgraded, so that the legitimate rights and interests of the prevailing farmers can be realized as soon as possible. For non-litigation enforcement cases where the person subject to enforcement is a farmer, a strict review according to law shall be conducted; if the statutory conditions for compulsory enforcement are not met, a ruling of non-enforcement shall be made; for petitions related to litigation in rural areas, the spirit of the National Conference on Petitions Related to Litigation of the People's Courts shall be earnestly implemented, and they shall be handled prudently in strict accordance with the law; for cases still in the process of trial, petitioners shall be informed to continue participating in the litigation, and the accepting people's court shall be urged to promptly try the case according to law; for cases meeting the conditions for retrial, the retrial procedure shall be promptly initiated according to law; for persistent petitioners who engage in unreasonable litigation, under the leadership of the local party committee, the supervision of the people's congress, and the support and cooperation of the government, efforts shall be made to persuade them to accept the judgment and cease petitions.

5. Give full play to the important role of basic people's courts and their dispatched people's tribunals in hearing agriculture-related cases. The vast majority of agriculture-related cases occur at the grassroots level. Basic people's courts and their dispatched people's tribunals shall place the trial of agriculture-related cases on an important agenda and make overall arrangements in light of local actual conditions. In the process of trying agriculture-related cases, they shall effectively strengthen litigation guidance and litigation risk reminders to help farmer litigants correctly exercise their litigation rights; they shall effectively pay attention to strengthening litigation mediation work, in accordance with the principle of mediating when mediation is possible, adjudicating when adjudication is necessary, and combining adjudication with mediation, improve the level of mediation work, try to resolve disputes through patient and meticulous ideological work, promote mutual understanding and concession among the parties, and reach a mediation agreement on the basis of equality and voluntariness; they shall give full play to the function of the summary civil procedure in resolving disputes in a timely, simple, and swift manner to reduce litigation costs and promptly protect farmers' legitimate rights and interests; they shall pay attention to giving play to the role of grassroots people's mediation organizations in mediating agriculture-related civil cases; while strengthening guidance on the work of grassroots people's mediation organizations, for agriculture-related civil cases involving people's mediation agreements, the Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Trial of Civil Cases Involving People's Mediation Agreements shall be followed to uphold the validity of such mediation agreements; for group dispute cases, reports shall be actively made to the party committee; under the leadership of the local party committee, the supervision of the people's congress, and the support of the government, ideological work shall be properly done on the parties to prevent conflict escalation, and efforts shall be made to resolve conflicts locally and at the grassroots level.

People's courts at all levels must pay attention to in-depth investigation and research and timely sum up trial experience. Higher people's courts shall strengthen guidance to lower people's courts on the trial of agriculture-related cases. New situations and new problems of a common nature arising in judicial practice shall be carefully studied and properly handled; when necessary, they shall be reported level by level to this Court.

June 28, 2004
